{{Top|leg}}
A '''superiority fighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was designed to be effective against both larger [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class XG-1 "Star Wing"]] and the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] were superiority fighters.<ref name="MtS7">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop7|text=Message to Spacers 7}}</ref>
